purpose.description: Your code sets up a Broadway-style landing page and implements fixed header behavior, full-width header, horizontally aligned nav items, and a three-column supporting section as per the project tasks.
The page structure aligns with the Tasks: header, main hero, and three supporting columns beneath the image, fulfilling the overall goal of practicing display and positioning in CSS.

readability.description: Nice use of semantic structure (header, main, section, footer) and clear separation of concerns with CSS.
Selects descriptive class names like .supporting and .container; consider adding comments for layout decisions and ensuring consistent indentation for readability.

performance.description: Fixed header and z-index work together to keep navigation visible over content, improving user experience during scroll.
Some responsive tweaks present (media query); ensure the 80px offset on main aligns with header height across all devices and consider reducing fixed heights for better flexibility.
